page.layout: One printed page. Above the text: a woodcut ornament band and the dedication title in large type, centred (full width). Below it: a dedication line in small caps. Then a body of text in two blocks: a woodcut initial with running text at the left-centre, text continuing to the right edge. Bottom right: a signature mark. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Illustris. & Serenis. Principi ac Domino, Domino Guilielmo, Landgravio Hassiæ, Comiti Cattimelibocorum, Deciorum, Zigenhani, Niddæ, &c.

page.notes: The first word of the body is a large woodcut initial "C" (decorated with a helmeted figure), joined to the following text as "CLEANTHEN"; the printed text reads "LEANTHEN" beside the woodcut, so the initial letter is the woodcut C and is not transcribed separately. The Greek line is printed in Greek letters with a reduced, partly worn appearance; the accents and the single word "ἀπαιδεύτους" are a best reading, marked as uncertain in the Greek: the first word is partly obscured by the woodcut initial area and is not verified letter by letter. The Greek sequence "μόνῃ τῇ μορφῇ τ᾽ ἀνθρώπων ἀπολείπειν" is the most likely printed text but the final word is read from a worn print and should be checked. The page text in the bottom-left is cropped by the scan edge at the right; the ornament band and title are not transcribed as text beyond the lines shown. Page is torn at the right edge; no words are lost in the visible lines.
